description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pahala Makandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title for a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 74, Block No. 07) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and title classification. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it deals with land registration and title settlement matters.
